title: README news refreshed
summary:
A quiet documentation day: the README caught up with GPT image model news.

The README now includes a March 11 news item about a region change for `gpt-image-1-mini` and `gpt-image-1.5` intended to avoid content-filter blocks on the Unified API. An older `pollinations-ui` news item was removed from the list. This PR updated documentation, not the models themselves.
